answer: Semantic similarity slashing: each agent embeds its epoch answer; the echo of near-identical vectors across wallets flags a farm. An oasis of verified diverse answers forms, and a falcon-like watcher pair audits outliers, slashing both partners' stake. Cloning N identities costs N stakes plus matched slashes, so a 20-wallet farm loses 20 stakes at first detection. This works because duplicate semantics are cheap to produce but expensive to defend.
